extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Adding fractions after converting them to common denominators.

extracted_concepts.name: Standard measurement units
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard units used to measure quantities such as length and volume.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional object.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional plane used to locate points with coordinates.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sorting plane figures into categories based on their properties.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities by division.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Using ratios to solve problems and compare quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A ratio describing how much of one quantity corresponds to one unit of another.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest common factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest factor shared by two or more numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least common multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest multiple shared by two or more numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical phrases combining numbers, variables, and operations.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding the value of an expression at specific variable values.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions that have the same value for all allowed variable values.

extracted_concepts.name: Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statements asserting that two expressions are equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Solving equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding values that make an equation true.

extracted_concepts.name: Three-dimensional figures
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solid figures having length, width, and height.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical question

extracted_concepts.name: Distributions

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary values such as mean, median, and mode.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary values describing how data vary, such as range.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The study of collecting, summarizing, and interpreting data.
